description: This source file defines the ElasticsearchConfig class which configures analyzers and token filters for Elasticsearch integration in the OpenMRS project. It sets up different analyzers for search functionality, including standard, whitespace, ngram, edge_ngram, and phonetic analyzers.

classes.name: ElasticsearchConfig
classes.description: Provides configuration for Elasticsearch analyzers and token filters in the OpenMRS project.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures various analyzers and token filters for Elasticsearch analysis context.
